text:
Cam: quick post-onboard notes for Helios Labs 1: they surfaced several product asks, one churn-watch signal, and some enablement gaps. pasting raw highlights.
Bea: drop the top 4 items so we can triage + assign?
Cam: TL;DR top items: 1) semantic filter drift in embeddings search 1 (results exclude recent SKUs after weekly retrain) 2) need team-scoped rate limits & quota view in Console (they onboard multiple squads) 3) Console walkthrough missing steps for SSO + role provisioning (CSM had to handhold) 4) request for a lightweight CSV export of feedback & acceptance criteria captured during onboarding. also they reported a confusing error when calling the incremental-index API.
Rohan: for #1 can you paste a minimal repro (query + expected vs actual)? even one example helps triage.
Cam: pasted snippet + meeting link: https://app.redwood/meetings/helios-2026-09-09/transcript 
Cam: ```
query: "filter products: material:carbon, sku contains 'HX'"
expected_ids: ["HX-1001","HX-1002","HX-1007"]
actual_ids: ["HX-1001"]  // HX-1002 and HX-1007 missing after last embedding refresh
```
Lydia: renewal-watch note  CSM said Helios has a renewal review in 3 weeks and is evaluating vendor reliability for search-driven flows. marking `renewal-watch`.
Bea: owners? @Rohan can you reproduce the embedding drift today and indicate if it's an ingestion or model-encoding regression?
Rohan: will repro. initial hunch: embedding encoding drift after retrain or an incremental job skipped some docs. if ingestion bug, short fix; model-variant drift might require re-eval. will update.
Cam: incremental-index API error they hit: ```
POST /v1/index/delta { "dataset":"helios-products", "file":"delta-0908.ndjson" }
response 400 { "error":"partial_ingest","missing": 23, "hint":"retry with smaller batches" }
// customer expected either clearer guidance or automated retry logic
```
Lydia: that partial_ingest is scary for them during initial onboarding  could push to churn if we don't offer guidance.
Bea: CSV export ask is simple  they want to pull onboarding feedback + acceptance criteria so their PMs can triage. that seems like a small docs + Console button add. @Cam can you capture exact columns they want?
Cam: they want: customer_note, CSM_action, acceptance_criteria, owner, status, created_at. also want ability to tag rows with `onboarding-risk` or `renewal-watch`.
Rohan: embedding repro action plan: 1) reproduce missing ids locally 2) check ingestion logs for skipped docs 3) verify embedding model version used in last refresh. estimate initial triage by EOD.
Bea: docs/UX: I'll open a small PR to add CSV export + a short Console hint about retrying incremental-index with chunk sizes. small canary today.
Lydia: product ask on team-scoped rate limits  Helios wants: a) per-team ceilings, b) ability to delegate quota admin to team leads, c) alerts when team usage > 80% month-to-date. sounds like a product backlog item.
Bea: action items recap: (1) Rohan reproduce embedding drift + post repro steps & ETA (owner: Rohan) (2) Bea to PR docs + Console hint + canary for CSV export (owner: Bea) (3) Cam to file FEED ticket with call notes + Helios acceptance criteria (owner: Cam) (4) Lydia to coordinate renewal outreach & interim mitigations (owner: Lydia).
Cam: created FEED-60021 and attached notes/transcript: https://app.redwood/feedback/FEED-60021  please tag `onboarding`, `search`, `indexing`, `rbac` and add estimates.
feedback-bot: FEED-60021 created and linked to Helios Labs. Priority: P1.
Lydia: interim mitigation suggestions: a) share a sample prompt and a small post-process that appends missing SKU patterns, b) offer a short managed-index rollback to previous embedding snapshot for the next 72h while we triage. I'll draft the CSM email.
Rohan: repro in progress  initial logs show 2 ingestion workers failed for a short window due to S3 throttling; posting logs to FEED-60021 now. if that's the root cause, short mitigation: re-run delta and increase chunk concurrency for their account. ETA: 2 business days.
Bea: thanks team :thumbsup:  let's aim for a triage update by EOD tomorrow and a docs canary today. Cam, please schedule a 15m follow-up with Helios CSM if Rohan's repro finds a concrete mitigation.
